negatives.observed: The first concurrent candidate validation started before the report builder completed; it also measured the overview at 1716 regex words against the 1800-word floor.
negatives.resolution: Run report construction and validation sequentially and extend the overview to 1911 regex words.

negatives.observed: The first sequential report validation found the exact accessibility boundary phrase split by a source newline.
negatives.resolution: Keep the bounded phrase contiguous in the static HTML and rerun the 140-check validator.

negatives.observed: The first candidate-receipt apply-patch targeted compact checklist lines while the generated JSON used expanded objects; patch verification rejected the entire change.
negatives.resolution: Read the actual generated checklist and apply a narrower structural patch; no partial change occurred.

negatives.observed: A combined register, log, truth, and overview patch used stale overview context and was rejected atomically before any file changed.
negatives.resolution: Split generator changes from regenerated-artifact changes and rebuild from the corrected generator.

negatives.observed: The first two-snapshot materialization command exceeded its wrapper timeout after snapshot A completed and snapshot B remained locked initializing.
negatives.resolution: Inspect both paths, retain completed snapshot A, remove only the verified incomplete snapshot B worktree, and recreate B alone with a longer bound; both final snapshots then matched the evidence head and were clean.

negatives.observed: The first post-snapshot repository suite failed one v642-v3 test because the environment receipt used verified_bounded_same_owner while the validator contract required the exact token verified.
negatives.resolution: Retain the stronger boundary in separate claim text, restore the contract token to verified, and rerun the complete suite.

negatives.observed: The second post-snapshot repository suite failed one v642-v3 test because both validators still required new_count 25 after N26 increased it to 26.
negatives.resolution: Update both count contracts together, retain this failure, and rerun the complete suite.

negatives.observed: A final verification wrapper piped validator JSON through Select-Object -First, which closed the producer early and returned a wrapper failure after the full validator had emitted valid=true and 141/141.
negatives.resolution: Consume validator output fully with Out-Null or write it to its receipt, preserve the wrapper failure, and rerun both validators.

boundary: All failed validation or patch attempts remain retained even though later execution passed.
